class.name: AssetTagCoordinator
class.brief_description: Coordinates dictionary and asset-index mutations for asset tags.
class.description: [AssetTagCoordinator] wraps [AssetTagRegistry] batch transactions for rename/remove operations and exposes undo snapshots via [method undo_last_change].

method.name: add_tag
method.description: Adds [param tag_name] to the tag dictionary inside a coordinated transaction. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] code if the manager/registry is unavailable or the add fails.

method.name: begin_transaction
method.description: Starts a coordinated registry batch and captures an undo snapshot.

method.name: can_undo
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when an undo snapshot is available.

method.name: remove_tag
method.description: Removes [param tag_name] from the dictionary and strips it from indexed assets. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] code from [method remove_tag_result].

method.name: remove_tag_result
method.description: Removes [param tag_name] and returns a result dictionary with [code]ok[/code], optional [code]error[/code]/[code]error_code[/code], and [code]affected_assets[/code] on success.

method.name: rename_tag
method.description: Renames [param old_name] to [param new_name] in the dictionary and remaps indexed asset tags. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] code from [method rename_tag_result].

method.name: rename_tag_result
method.description: Renames a tag and returns a result dictionary with [code]ok[/code], optional [code]error[/code]/[code]error_code[/code], and [code]affected_assets[/code] on success.

method.name: schedule_prune_removed_paths
method.description: Schedules a debounced prune of index entries whose asset paths no longer exist.

method.name: undo_last_change
method.description: Restores the last undo snapshot to disk and reloads manager/registry state.

method.name: update_tag_comment
method.description: Updates the comment for [param tag_name] inside a coordinated transaction. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] code if the update fails.
